rationale: Synthetic IID Beta-Binomial cohort matching the W1 5-bin calibration marginals; 5,000 samples; 50/50 calibration/validation split. Validation-fold coverage is the marginal guarantee the runtime promises.
references: Vovk V, Gammerman A, Shafer G. Algorithmic Learning in a Random World. 2nd ed. Springer (2022).
